Its ₪79 (initial-2026-10-11; price_note '33×183') was set for CJYD242507912LO (33x183, $3.68); the designer moved the default to 33x122 on 2026-11-07 (d69679d1), before 7b42ddc1, and make-price-anchors.py takes the default at 7b42ddc1. So the gate is silent. Today 92-153 cm ₪79, 183 and 228 ₪89, 275 ₪99 (183 was priced ₪79). The other 161/162 anchors are right.
